description: Ask the registrar for the transfer (EPP / auth) code of a domain registered at GlobalHostia, to move it to another registrar. Depending on the registrar the code is returned here or emailed to the domain's registrant contact. Anyone with the code can start a transfer, so it needs confirm: true after the customer approves. At most 3 requests per hour.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

domain.description: A domain on your account, e.g. mybrand.com

name: get_transfer_code
title: Request a domain transfer code
